Sets the color that is read where an address mode is border (3), see [SamplerAddressModeU](SamplerAddressModeU). The color goes from 0 to 1 for each part, and values outside of it are kept inside. The default is opaque black (0, 0, 0, 1). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
@param sampler  The sampler to change.
@param r        Red, 0 to 1.
@param g        Green, 0 to 1.
@param b        Blue, 0 to 1.
@param a        Alpha, 0 to 1.
@gap Graphics cards without the `VK_EXT_custom_border_color` extension can only do transparent black, opaque black and opaque white, so any other color is read as the closest of the three. Colors from this command are still returned as they were set by the `GetSamplerBorderColor` commands.
